mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over 3 consecutive months signals a shift toward monetary easing, lowering discount rates and increasing the present value of expected equity cash flows, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05), or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the federal funds rate above 4.5% for 3 consecutive months signals tightening monetary policy, raising discount rates and compressing the present value of expected equity cash flows, which drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns in tightening periods are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05), or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in monthly employment growth (PAYEMS) above 100,000 jobs for 3 consecutive months signals a strengthening labor market, which increases consumer confidence and corporate earnings expectations, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns in strengthening periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05), or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in monthly employment growth (PAYEMS) below 100,000 jobs for 3 consecutive months signals a weakening labor market, which reduces consumer confidence and corporate earnings expectations, driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns in weakening periods are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05), or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 113.9 for 3 consecutive months signals weakening domestic demand, which reduces corporate earnings expectations and compresses equity valuations, driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns in weakening periods are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05), or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in industrial production (INDPRO) above 113.9 for 3 consecutive months signals strengthening domestic supply capacity, which boosts corporate earnings expectations and equity valuations, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns in strengthening periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05), or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the CPIAUCSL inflation index above 2% for 3 consecutive months signals a disinflationary trend, which reduces the real discount rate and increases the present value of expected equity cash flows, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns in disinflation periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05), or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in monthly unemployment (UNRATE) above 5% for 3 consecutive months signals a labor market softening, which reduces consumer confidence and corporate earnings expectations, driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns in softening periods are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05), or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.
